pokemon.name: bulbasaur
pokemon.description: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

pokemon.name: ivysaur
pokemon.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

pokemon.name: venusaur
pokemon.description: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

pokemon.name: charmander
pokemon.description: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

pokemon.name: charmeleon
pokemon.description: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

pokemon.name: charizard
pokemon.description: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

pokemon.name: squirtle
pokemon.description: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

pokemon.name: wartortle
pokemon.description: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

pokemon.name: blastoise
pokemon.description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

pokemon.name: caterpie
pokemon.description: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

pokemon.name: metapod
pokemon.description: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

pokemon.name: butterfree
pokemon.description: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

pokemon.name: weedle
pokemon.description: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

pokemon.name: kakuna
pokemon.description: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

pokemon.name: beedrill
pokemon.description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

pokemon.name: pidgey
pokemon.description: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

pokemon.name: pidgeotto
pokemon.description: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

pokemon.name: pidgeot
pokemon.description: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

pokemon.name: rattata
pokemon.description: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

pokemon.name: raticate
pokemon.description: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

pokemon.name: spearow
pokemon.description: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

pokemon.name: fearow
pokemon.description: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

pokemon.name: ekans
pokemon.description: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

pokemon.name: arbok
pokemon.description: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

pokemon.name: pikachu
pokemon.description: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

pokemon.name: raichu
pokemon.description: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

pokemon.name: sandshrew
pokemon.description: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

pokemon.name: sandslash
pokemon.description: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feel when touched.

pokemon.name: nidoran-f
pokemon.description: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they’ll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

pokemon.name: nidorina
pokemon.description: The horn on its head has atrophied. It’s thought that this happens so Nidorina’s children won’t get poked while their mother is feeding them.

pokemon.name: nidoqueen
pokemon.description: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense. With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield its children from any kind of attack.

pokemon.name: nidoran-m
pokemon.description: The horn on a male Nidoran’s forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.

pokemon.name: nidorino
pokemon.description: With a horn that’s harder than diamond, this Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it searches for a moon stone.

pokemon.name: nidoking
pokemon.description: When it goes on a rampage, it’s impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it’s lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

pokemon.name: clefairy
pokemon.description: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

pokemon.name: clefable
pokemon.description: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

pokemon.name: vulpix
pokemon.description: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

pokemon.name: ninetales
pokemon.description: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

pokemon.name: jigglypuff
pokemon.description: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokémon. It won’t stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.

pokemon.name: wigglytuff
pokemon.description: The more air it takes in, the more it inflates. If opponents catch it in a bad mood, it will inflate itself to an enormous size to intimidate them.

pokemon.name: zubat
pokemon.description: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

pokemon.name: golbat
pokemon.description: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.

pokemon.name: oddish
pokemon.description: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

pokemon.name: gloom
pokemon.description: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

pokemon.name: vileplume
pokemon.description: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

pokemon.name: paras
pokemon.description: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.

pokemon.name: parasect
pokemon.description: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

pokemon.name: venonat
pokemon.description: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

pokemon.name: venomoth
pokemon.description: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

pokemon.name: diglett
pokemon.description: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

pokemon.name: dugtrio
pokemon.description: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

pokemon.name: meowth
pokemon.description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

pokemon.name: persian
pokemon.description: Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.

pokemon.name: psyduck
pokemon.description: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

pokemon.name: golduck
pokemon.description: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

pokemon.name: mankey
pokemon.description: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

pokemon.name: primeape
pokemon.description: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

pokemon.name: growlithe
pokemon.description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

pokemon.name: arcanine
pokemon.description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

pokemon.name: poliwag
pokemon.description: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

pokemon.name: poliwhirl
pokemon.description: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

pokemon.name: poliwrath
pokemon.description: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

pokemon.name: abra
pokemon.description: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

pokemon.name: kadabra
pokemon.description: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

pokemon.name: alakazam
pokemon.description: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

pokemon.name: machop
pokemon.description: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

pokemon.name: machoke
pokemon.description: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

pokemon.name: machamp
pokemon.description: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

pokemon.name: bellsprout
pokemon.description: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

pokemon.name: weepinbell
pokemon.description: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

pokemon.name: victreebel
pokemon.description: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

pokemon.name: tentacool
pokemon.description: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

pokemon.name: tentacruel
pokemon.description: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

pokemon.name: geodude
pokemon.description: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

pokemon.name: graveler
pokemon.description: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

pokemon.name: golem
pokemon.description: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

pokemon.name: ponyta
pokemon.description: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

pokemon.name: rapidash
pokemon.description: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

pokemon.name: slowpoke
pokemon.description: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice when its tail grows back, either.

pokemon.name: slowbro
pokemon.description: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

pokemon.name: magnemite
pokemon.description: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

pokemon.name: magneton
pokemon.description: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

pokemon.name: farfetchd
pokemon.description: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

pokemon.name: doduo
pokemon.description: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

pokemon.name: dodrio
pokemon.description: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

pokemon.name: seel
pokemon.description: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokemon.name: dewgong
pokemon.description: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

pokemon.name: grimer
pokemon.description: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

pokemon.name: muk
pokemon.description: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

pokemon.name: shellder
pokemon.description: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

pokemon.name: cloyster
pokemon.description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

pokemon.name: gastly
pokemon.description: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

pokemon.name: haunter
pokemon.description: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

pokemon.name: gengar
pokemon.description: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

pokemon.name: onix
pokemon.description: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

pokemon.name: drowzee
pokemon.description: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

pokemon.name: hypno
pokemon.description: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

pokemon.name: krabby
pokemon.description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

pokemon.name: kingler
pokemon.description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

pokemon.name: voltorb
pokemon.description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

moves.name: absorb
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: acid
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: acid-armor
moves.description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: acid-spray
moves.description: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: acrobatics
moves.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
moves.effect: Has double power if the user has no held item.

moves.name: acupressure
moves.description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.
moves.effect: Raises one of a friendly Pokémon’s stats at random by two stages.

moves.name: aerial-ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.
moves.effect: Never misses.

moves.name: after-you
moves.description: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
moves.effect: Makes the target act next this turn.

moves.name: agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: air-cutter
moves.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

moves.name: air-slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: alluring-voice
moves.description: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

moves.name: ally-switch
moves.description: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.effect: User switches places with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.

moves.name: amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: ancient-power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.
moves.effect: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.

moves.name: aqua-jet
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: aqua-ring
moves.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
moves.effect: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP each turn.

moves.name: aqua-tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: aromatherapy
moves.description: This move can't be used. It's recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can't be remembered.
moves.effect: Cures the entire party of major status effects.

moves.name: assist
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Randomly selects and uses one of the trainer’s other Pokémon’s moves.

moves.name: assurance
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.
moves.effect: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.

moves.name: astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: attract
moves.description: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.
moves.effect: Target falls in love if it has the opposite gender, and has a 50% chance to refuse attacking the user.

moves.name: aura-sphere
moves.description: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
moves.effect: Never misses.

moves.name: aurora-beam
moves.description: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: autotomize
moves.description: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages and halves the user’s weight.

moves.name: avalanche
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.

moves.name: baby-doll-eyes
moves.description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: barrier
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: baton-pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
moves.effect: Allows the trainer to switch out the user and pass effects along to its replacement.

moves.name: beat-up
moves.description: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
moves.effect: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.

moves.name: belch
moves.description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
moves.effect: Can only be used after the user has eaten a berry.

moves.name: belly-drum
moves.description: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.
moves.effect: User pays half its max HP to max out its Attack.

moves.name: bestow
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Gives the user’s held item to the target.

moves.name: bide
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: User waits for two turns, then hits back for twice the damage it took.

moves.name: bind
moves.description: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
moves.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

moves.name: bite
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: blast-burn
moves.description: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

moves.name: blaze-kick
moves.description: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.
moves.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: block
moves.description: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.
moves.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

moves.name: body-press
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
moves.effect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.

moves.name: body-slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: bounce
moves.description: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: User bounces high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

moves.name: brave-bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.

moves.name: breaking-swipe
moves.description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.

moves.name: brick-break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
moves.effect: Destroys Reflect and Light Screen.

moves.name: brine
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.
moves.effect: Has double power against Pokémon that have less than half their max HP remaining.

moves.name: brutal-swing
moves.description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: bubble
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: bubble-beam
moves.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: bug-bite
moves.description: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
moves.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.

moves.name: bug-buzz
moves.description: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: bulk-up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.

moves.name: bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: bullet-punch
moves.description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: bullet-seed
moves.description: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.effect: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

moves.name: burn-up

moves.description: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.effect: Heals the user by the target’s current Attack stat and lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: string-shot
moves.description: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: struggle-bug
moves.description: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: stun-spore
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.
moves.effect: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: submission
moves.description: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.
moves.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.
moves.effect: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.

moves.name: sucker-punch
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
moves.effect: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.

moves.name: sunny-day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.
moves.effect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.

moves.name: super-fang
moves.description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.
moves.effect: Inflicts damage equal to half the target’s HP.

moves.name: superpower
moves.description: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.
moves.effect: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.

moves.name: supersonic
moves.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.
moves.effect: Confuses the target.

moves.name: surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.

moves.name: swagger
moves.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.
moves.effect: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages and confuses the target.

moves.name: swallow
moves.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.
moves.effect: Recovers 1/4 HP after one Stockpile, 1/2 HP after two Stockpiles, or full HP after three Stockpiles.

moves.name: sweet-kiss
moves.description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.
moves.effect: Confuses the target.

moves.name: sweet-scent
moves.description: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.

moves.name: swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
moves.effect: Never misses.

moves.name: switcheroo
moves.description: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.
moves.effect: User and target swap items.

moves.name: swords-dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: synchronoise
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Hits any Pokémon that shares a type with the user.

moves.name: synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.

moves.name: tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: tail-slap
moves.description: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.effect: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

moves.name: tail-whip
moves.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.
moves.effect: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.

moves.name: take-down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.
moves.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
moves.effect: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.

moves.name: teeter-dance
moves.description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.
moves.effect: Confuses the target.

moves.name: telekinesis
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Moves have 100% accuracy against the target for three turns.

moves.name: teleport
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if any. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.
moves.effect: Immediately ends wild battles. No effect otherwise.

moves.name: temper-flare
moves.description: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: tera-blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: terrain-pulse
moves.description: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
moves.effect: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.

moves.name: thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.
moves.effect: Takes the target’s item.

moves.name: thrash
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
moves.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.

moves.name: throat-chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
moves.effect: Prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

moves.name: thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: thunder-fang
moves.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: thunder-punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: thunder-shock
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: thunder-wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.
moves.effect: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: tickle
moves.description: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.

moves.name: torment
moves.description: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
moves.effect: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.

moves.name: toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
moves.effect: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.

moves.name: toxic-spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.effect: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.

moves.name: trailblaze
moves.description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: tri-attack
moves.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

moves.name: trick
moves.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.
moves.effect: User and target swap items.

moves.name: trick-room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
moves.effect: For five turns, slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.

moves.name: triple-axel
moves.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
moves.effect: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.

moves.name: trump-card
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Power increases when this move has less PP, up to a maximum of 200.

moves.name: twineedle
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Hits twice in the same turn. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: u-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.effect: User must switch out after attacking.

moves.name: upper-hand
moves.description: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

moves.name: uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.
moves.effect: Forced to use this move for several turns. Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.

moves.name: vacuum-wave
moves.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: venom-drench
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.

moves.name: venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
moves.effect: Inflicts double damage if the target is Poisoned.

moves.name: vice-grip
moves.description: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: vine-whip
moves.description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: vital-throw
moves.description: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.
moves.effect: Never misses.

moves.name: volt-switch
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.effect: User must switch out after attacking.

moves.name: volt-tackle
moves.description: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: wake-up-slap
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: If the target is asleep, has double power and wakes it up.

moves.name: water-gun
moves.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: water-pledge
moves.description: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a rainbow appears.
moves.effect: With Grass Pledge, halves opposing Pokémon’s Speed for four turns.

moves.name: water-pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.
moves.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: water-sport
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Halves all Fire-type damage.

moves.name: water-spout
moves.description: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
moves.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.

moves.name: waterfall
moves.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: wave-crash
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: weather-ball
moves.description: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.
moves.effect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.

moves.name: whirlpool
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
moves.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.

moves.name: whirlwind
moves.description: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
moves.effect: Immediately ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.

moves.name: wide-guard
moves.description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.
moves.effect: Prevents any multi-target moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.

moves.name: wild-charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.
moves.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: will-o-wisp
moves.description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.
moves.effect: Burns the target.

moves.name: wing-attack
moves.description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: wish
moves.description: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.
moves.effect: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.

moves.name: withdraw
moves.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: wonder-room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
moves.effect: All Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped for 5 turns.

moves.name: work-up
moves.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

moves.name: worry-seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.
moves.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.

moves.name: wrap
moves.description: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
moves.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

moves.name: wring-out
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.effect: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.

moves.name: x-scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: yawn
moves.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.
moves.effect: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.

moves.name: zap-cannon
moves.description: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: zen-headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
